_doc: Our corrections to John Felix's sheet, and notes on days it gets right but that read wrong.
Reviewed by hand: each entry is checked against the MoD's own posts (source).
corrections: report_date (the sheet's row date), section, item ('_total' for the MoD figure),
sheet_value (what the sheet holds — the correction applies only while it still does),
value, note (shown in the chart tooltip), source.
notes: section (or '*' for every metric), from/to report dates, weekday (Mon–Sun, optional),
note. Nothing changes; the note is shown on those days.
The ingest loads this on every run; see README 'Corrections'.

corrections.note: Corrected from 5,585: the sheet holds the MoD's whole weekly figure for 21–27 Oct here (5,585) rather than what is left of it after the six days already counted (4,435).

notes.note: Carries the whole week's claims in the Kursk area: the MoD reported those only in its weekly summary.
